prompt:
Create a draft visual asset for Vintage Telnet using the supplied art direction.

Asset type: creature

Target: Rediseño visual autorizado de fauna natural no combatiente de los Llanos de Edran; romper por completo la lectura dinosauriana antes de integrar a runtime.

Canonical name: Velozanco de Edran

Art direction: REDISEÑO VISUAL AUTORIZADO. Mantener la locomoción 4+2 y la adaptación al viento, pero abandonar la silueta previa. El Velozanco debe parecer un animal original de llanura construido alrededor de un cuerpo central bajo, ancho y suspendido, parecido en masa a una semilla o cápsula orgánica aplanada, no a un torso vertebrado con pecho, cuello y caderas. Seis apoyos nacen alrededor de la masa corporal: cuatro patas locomotoras largas y delgadas distribuidas en dos pares equilibrados y dos apoyos anteriores más cortos. Cabeza pequeña, roma y baja, parcialmente encajada bajo el borde frontal del cuerpo, sin cuello visible. Sin cola corporal reconocible: sólo dos cortos filamentos rígidos sensoriales emergen juntos del borde posterior. Sobre el lomo existe una banda membranosa blanda, baja y plegada por el viento, nunca una vela. Fauna ambiental, tímida y veloz. Paleta fría/neutra de Edran.

Aspect ratio: 1536x1024

Prompt: Create one original alien-but-natural plains animal for Vintage Telnet, shown completely in a low three-quarter side view in the Llanos de Edran. DESIGN FROM A NEW SILHOUETTE; do not imitate the previous reference image. Start from a broad, low, flattened seed-pod-shaped CENTRAL BODY suspended above the ground. The body must read as one continuous oval/capsule mass with NO chest, NO pelvis emphasis, NO upright torso and NO visible neck. Arrange exactly SIX weight-bearing supports around this central mass: four very long, slender locomotor legs in two balanced pairs, with the front and rear pair similar in visual importance, plus two noticeably shorter auxiliary supports near the lower front quarter. All six are legs/supports, never arms. The tiny blunt head is tucked low into the underside/front rim of the central body, almost like a sensory prow: broad and rounded, no muzzle, no beak, no reptile skull, no neck. At the rear there is NO conventional fleshy tail. Instead, exactly TWO short rigid sensory filaments project directly from the rear edge of the body, each much shorter than a leg. Across the upper body lies a LOW SOFT DORSAL MEMBRANE like a flexible strip of skin pressed flat sideways by the crosswind; it is not triangular and does not rise above the body as a sail. Give the animal smooth matte hide with subtle longitudinal folds, no scales and no armor. Pose it moving laterally with all six supports clearly understandable and the body staying level, like a wind-adapted ground runner rather than a predator. Natural cautious non-combat behavior. Background subordinate: muted green-gray field margins, blue-gray overcast sky, brown-gray soil and only sparse pale straw. Cool neutral daylight. The finished silhouette should be recognizable even as a black shape: low central capsule, four balanced stilts, two short front supports, tiny tucked-under head, and two tiny rear filaments.

Canon sources supplied by the Art Director: Issue #522 — Dirección de Arte, comentario del 2026-09-29; Autorización del usuario del 2026-09-30 para cambiar sustancialmente el arte de Velozanco

Do not include: ABSOLUTELY NO dinosaur, theropod, raptor, ornithopod, bird, lizard or reptile silhouette; No conventional vertebrate body plan with distinct chest, long neck, pelvis-heavy rear or counterbalancing tail; No visible neck; head must be tiny, blunt and tucked into the lower front edge of the body; No snout, muzzle, beak, reptilian skull, teeth or predatory face; No conventional tail; only exactly two short rigid rear sensory filaments emerging directly from the body edge; No bipedal impression and no oversized rear legs; front and rear long leg pairs must carry equal visual weight; Exactly six weight-bearing supports: four long locomotor legs plus two short anterior supports; No insect exoskeleton, segmented abdomen, antennae or arthropod head; No feathers, wings, dorsal sail, rigid fin, spikes, horns or armor; No dominant ochre, amber, yellow or golden palette; pale straw may appear only as a minor background accent; No sunset or golden-hour lighting; No attack pose, glow, magic, readable text or HUD

IDs (reference only): velozanco_edran

Notes: Rediseño fuerte autorizado tras fallos repetidos de lectura dinosauriana. Se retira deliberadamente la imagen de Fase 1 como referencia porque estaba anclando las nuevas generaciones a la silueta rechazada. Se conserva la función regional C0, el esquema locomotor 4+2, la adaptación al viento y los dos filamentos posteriores, pero se reconstruye la masa corporal desde una cápsula baja no vertebrada visualmente. No publicar hasta superar autocrítica.

issues: Head is too large and pointed instead of tiny, blunt and tucked under the front edge (visible snout-like projection).
Only one short anterior appendage is visible; the image does not show exactly two short, weight-bearing anterior supports.
Body silhouette is too elongated/torso-like rather than a low, wide, flattened seed/capsule mass.
critique.reasoning: The design violates several explicit constraints. The creature's head is prominent and pointed, forming a snout-like forward projection rather than a tiny, blunt head partially hidden under the front body edge. The underside shows a single dangling stub but not two short anterior supports required to make six distinct weight-bearing supports (four long locomotor legs + two short front supports). The overall body reads as an elongated, torso-like form instead of the mandated low, wide, suspended seed/capsule mass. Other required elements (two short rigid rear sensory filaments; a low folded membranous dorsal band; cold/neutral palette) are present, but the three issues above must be fixed.
